row.title: STANDARDS-FIRST-1: standards are measured rows with a decision; events, errors, configs, page markup and repository descriptors follow them
row.body: Rowan, 2026-11-25: 'Standards, don't reinvent the wheel. Apply standards. Figure out what the standards are and apply them broadly.' The existing register (seed/standards/standards.json) now carries, per audited row, the homegrown equivalent, the measured adoption, what conformance changes, the cost, a decision (adopt now, adopt later with a filed item, decline with a reason and the condition that reopens it) and probes that standards --check runs. Adopted by code: JSON Schema for configs (foundation/schemas.py, doctrine/schemas/index.json, shrink-only baseline), CloudEvents 1.0 on handoff and provenance writes, RFC 9457 on the shared error path, schema.org JSON-LD from the shared contract module, catalog-info.yaml from the manifest reconciler, Conventional Commits header lint on generated titles. Declined after evaluation: Terraform/OpenTofu, OPA, OTLP export, OpenSLO, AsyncAPI, SBOM (each row says why and when to look again). A failing row files through detectors standards-register and standards-live; a new release of an adopted standard is filed by the scout from its release feed.
